description: Evaluation cases for the generated Metro Vision AI Mission Console addon.

cases.prompt: Attach a mission console to the running loitering-detection deployment.
expect: Confirms the application is running and its tracked files are clean before generating.

Generates console/app.py, templates/index.html, static/{styles.css,whep.js,app.js}, Dockerfile, entrypoint.sh, requirements.txt, compose.console.yml and .env into an addon directory outside the application source tree.
Creates or edits no application file: config.json, nginx.conf, compose files, flows.json and Grafana dashboards are untouched.
Deploys with a compose file that joins the application network as an external network.
acceptance/verify.sh exits zero with --app-dir and --live.

cases.prompt: Add the console without changing anything in the application.
expect: Uses the released detection-properties parameter for model and device selection instead of editing config.json.
Terminates TLS in the console and proxies WHEP instead of editing nginx.conf.
Uses a separate compose file instead of editing the application's compose file.
git status in the application repository shows no modified tracked file attributable to the skill.

cases.prompt: Compare the detector the application ships with against a model I have just installed.
expect: Lists both models purely from discovery in the mounted model store.
Names no specific model in generated code, configuration or documentation.
Starts two pipelines on the same source with distinct peer identifiers.
Supplies a distinct model-instance-id derived from model and device on each request.
Reports independent FPS, dwell and loiter figures per panel.

cases.prompt: Verify the console works on CPU, GPU and NPU.
expect: Offers only devices the host provides and marks the others disabled.
Starts successfully on each available device with any discovered model.
Does not reuse the released model-instance identifier, so a model change does not bind to a previously loaded network.
Live verification exercises every available device rather than CPU alone.

cases.prompt: Draw a new loitering zone on the video and apply it.
expect: Converts screen coordinates to source pixels using the intrinsic video size and letterbox offsets.
Applies the zone through api/zone; the pipeline instance is not stopped, relaunched or renegotiated.
Subsequent telemetry reflects the new zone.

cases.prompt: Dwell time in the console is much lower than the application dashboard reports.
expect: Measures dwell on the frame timestamp carried in the metadata, not on message arrival time.
Measures dwell against zone occupancy so that a tracker identifier reassignment does not reset it.
Applies a vacancy grace period before clearing the zone entry timestamp.
Retains tracks under a time-to-live rather than evicting them at the reporting interval.
Reports the greater of zone dwell and the longest per-track dwell.

cases.prompt: Deploy the console on a second machine.
expect: Emits the locked design tokens verbatim and every required element identifier.
Produces a dashboard indistinguishable from the first deployment.
Passes the same gate without weakening any assertion.

cases.prompt: /loitering-detection-ui is reported as an unknown command.
expect: Explains that the identifier is the front-matter name and is lower-case.
Explains that the repository containing .github/skills/loitering-detection-ui must be open as a workspace folder for the command to resolve.
Offers engagement by description as an alternative.
